title: Mirabel and the Gravity
author: Felix Nystrom
blurb: Mara Vane, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
